component.name: DeepSeek Harness
component.summary: Native desktop workbench and runtime for DeepSeek agents

description.p: DeepSeek Harness is an open-source agent workbench capable of running multi-turn coding tasks, autonomous browser/computer interactions, background automation, and reasoning workflows.

ul.li: Native Linux desktop integration for GNOME, KDE Plasma, XFCE, and modern desktop environments.
System tray presence and background execution with instant window restore.
Full DeepSeek-V3, DeepSeek-V4, and DeepSeek-R1 model support.
Composable plugin micro-framework powered by Cordis.

description.p: Linux desktop release with native window integration, system tray support, and instant re-focusing.
